metaTitle: BMW Engine Rebuild Warranty Explained | BMW Garage
metaDescription: What a BMW engine rebuild warranty covers, typical terms, exclusions and BMW-specific requirements. 12-month unlimited-mileage guarantee included with every rebuild from BMW Garage.
lede: Every BMW engine rebuild from our workshop comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage guarantee covering workmanship and components. Here's exactly what that means for you.

sections.heading: What Our BMW Rebuild Warranty Covers

blocks.html: An engine rebuild warranty is a workshop's guarantee covering the quality of workmanship and the components used during the rebuild. It is not an insurance product or a third-party extended warranty — it's our own commitment to the work we carry out.
All BMW engine rebuilds completed at BMW Garage include a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty as standard. This is a fully inclusive guarantee, with no additional purchase required.

items.q: What does the 12-month warranty actually cover?
items.a: Our warranty covers workmanship (assembly, machining) and components replaced during the rebuild. If a covered part fails or the workmanship proves defective within 12 months, we remedy it at no extra cost.
No — the warranty is unlimited mileage for the full 12-month term.

items.q: What does the warranty not cover?
items.a: Consequential damage beyond the failed component itself, damage from neglect or misuse, modifications (e.g. aftermarket tuning), and normal wear-and-tear after the 12-month period. Pre-existing conditions not addressed during the rebuild are also excluded.

items.q: Do I need to follow a running-in procedure?
items.a: Yes — proper running-in is essential for BMW engines, particularly those with tight tolerances (VANOS, timing systems, M-division engines). We provide full written guidance at collection.

items.q: Are oil changes required during the warranty period?
items.a: Yes — the warranty requires the first oil change at 400–600 miles, and a second at 900–1,100 miles, then servicing at BMW intervals. This ensures the rebuild beds in correctly.

items.q: Does the warranty transfer to a new owner if I sell the car?
items.a: The warranty is non-transferable — it applies to the original vehicle and the customer who commissioned the rebuild.

items.q: How long does a rebuild take?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days after inspection. Complex M-division or V-engine rebuilds may take longer — we will confirm the timeline when you book.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on replacement engines too?
items.a: Yes — our replacement engines also carry a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, subject to the same terms (running-in, service schedule, exclusions).
